preconditions.description: s1 and s2 must be strings.
s1 and s2 must have the same length.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'xy' for c in s1) and all(c in 'xy' for c in s2)
preconditions.description: s1 and s2 must only contain the characters 'x' and 'y'.

postconditions.description: The return value must be -1 or a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (all(s1[i] == s2[i] for i in range(len(s1))))
postconditions.description: If the return value is not -1, s1 and s2 must be equal after the minimum number of swaps.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (return_value == sum((s1[i] != s2[i]) for i in range(len(s1))) // 2)
postconditions.description: If the return value is not -1, it must be the minimum number of swaps required to make s1 and s2 equal.
